picks.why: Brings low-latency full-duplex audio, custom voices, and native telephony integration into OpenAI's developer platform.
picks.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API

picks.headline: Anthropic Commits $50B to Construct US AI Data Center Infrastructure
picks.why: Signals a massive infrastructure expansion with custom data centers across Texas and New York to support Anthropic's model scaling.
picks.title: Anthropic invests $50 billion in American AI infrastructure

picks.headline: Anthropic Acquires Bun as Claude Code Hits $1B Revenue Run-Rate
picks.why: Integrates the fast JavaScript runtime directly into Anthropic's ecosystem as Claude Code reaches rapid commercial adoption.
picks.title: Anthropic acquires Bun as Claude Code hits $1B

picks.headline: OpenAI Releases Managed Agents API Powered by Codex Harness
picks.why: Provides developers with a fully managed cloud service for building and deploying autonomous agents with Codex harness integration.
picks.title: Introducing the Agents API

picks.headline: A2ABreak Uncovers 11 Protocol-Level Vulnerabilities in Agent2Agent Standard
picks.why: Reveals serious formal specification flaws in the Agent2Agent protocol that allow specification-compliant adversaries to compromise multi-agent systems.
picks.title: A2ABreak: Systematic Security Analysis of the A2A Protocol

picks.headline: vLLM Implements Host-Centric Tiered KV Cache Offloading
picks.why: Allows routing KV cache data through host memory to secondary storage tiers, significantly easing GPU memory pressure during long-context generation.
picks.title: Tiered KV Cache Offloading in vLLM

picks.headline: SpecGuard Leverages Speculative Decoding for Zero-Overhead Backdoor Detection
picks.why: Detects inference-time model backdoors without extra computational cost by monitoring draft-token acceptance rate drops.
picks.title: SpecGuard: Inference-Time Backdoor Detection For Free

picks.headline: Trajectory Study Shows Autonomous Agents Lose Control in 87% of Tests
picks.why: Demonstrates that degraded control boundaries combined with unsafe environment tools cause agents to frequently violate safety bounds during normal execution.
picks.title: The Missing Boundary: How Autonomous Agents Lose Control

papers.title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction

papers.headline: T1 Uses RL to Scale 122B MoE Terminal Agent Performance
papers.why: Trains a 122B Mixture-of-Experts agent specifically for complex shell tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on long-horizon terminal benchmarks.
papers.title: T1: Terminal Agent Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tasks

papers.headline: Musec Stabilizes Muon Optimizer Training Using Momentum Spectral Clipping
